additional_info.subject: ID0480076-DC/Si-D/MC- [Y2 / R9 313202799094] Charging Station Technical Faults CRM:03431000100
additional_info.body:
Dear Spano,
Thank you for your email back.
Just to clarify all your request.
Regarding the first request mentioning the door sensor. In the report, the engineer concluded that he had to remove the wedges of the door so the sensor wouldn`t be triggered.
After this operation, the engineer did some test and he concluded that this resolved the problem, and the tests came out OK.
The PLC is not triggered by the door sensor anymore, because if this was the case, we would have received some errors in the logs and the errorflag of the PLC being triggered. This is not the case, which means this is not an issue anymore.
Coming back on your second request, which has to do with the power delivery of the car. We have tracked the charging session, and see that the issue is related to the EV, and not the charger.
As you can see in the following log, during the cable check, the charger is able to provide the full 180kw in power. If there was something wrong with the charger, the power delivery would have not been reached during this fase.
Hereby another log of during the charging session, were you are able to see that the charger is providing only the power that the car is asking for.
The charger will only provide the charging power, that the car is asking for. In this case the car was not asking for more power, so the charger also didn`t provide this.
This being said, we will monitor the charger for the coming three days to see if any of these requests appear again.
We hope to have informed you enough.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum

Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0480076
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: SMEG
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 / R9 313202799094
Charger ID / Serial No.:
UwYvBp
Charger address/functional location: Monaco
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason: Door sensor check
Following the request of the client, the client informs us that a technician has been on-site to remove the wedges from the door, so the door sensor wouldn`t be triggered anymore.
We want to ask you to check the front door of the charger, to make sure it still closes correctly, and the removal of the wedges didn`t cause a problem on the charger, or the sensor.
The engineer who performed this action said the following:
Refermer la porte une fois redémarrer et en tirant légèrement sur la porte le
capteur de porte se déclenche .(Du coup détection porte et si quelqu'un clique
sur fermer cela éteint la borne)
Du coup retrait des cales sur système de fermeture et j'ai rajouté une cale sur le
capteur de porte.
Le capteur est beaucoup moins sensible et la porte moins facile à ouvrir malgré
qu'il reste encore du jeu dans la partie haute.
Please make sure to check the door, the wedges and the door sensor, to make sure this won`t cause any problems in the future.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Priscilla van Wettum
